name: onn 4K Streaming Box (2023)
summary: Clean up the onn 4K Streaming Box (2023): switch off feedback reporting and preloaded apps with a free phone app, a backup first and one-tap undo.
intro: The 2023 onn 4K Streaming Box from Walmart is already fairly light. It still has Google feedback reporting, Play Games, the Google TV movies app, a print service and a setup wizard that can grab the home screen back. This list covers those seven apps.

It was tested on Google TV 14. The remote's app buttons and mic kept working, because the onn remote service stays on. The Google Photos screensaver also keeps working, since ambient mode is kept. TidyTV turns the apps off from your phone over Wi-Fi, saves a backup first, and deletes nothing.
keep: Google Assistant for the remote's mic button
Ambient mode, so the Google Photos screensaver keeps working
The onn remote app buttons and update prompts
Amlogic services for HDMI, picture and remote pairing
Remote firmware updates and the phone remote service
Play Store, Play Services and Gboard
notes: The box has no HDMI inputs or Live TV, since it is a box.
The Wi-Fi network saved during first setup belongs to the setup wizard. Forget it and join it again in Settings before turning the wizard off, or the network is deleted.
With a VPN connected, Settings shows the VPN address instead of the one on your home network.

faq.q: Will the voice button still work on my onn box?
faq.a: Yes. Google Assistant and the onn remote service both stay on, so the mic and the remote's app buttons keep working.

faq.q: Will my Google Photos screensaver still work?
faq.a: Yes. Ambient mode is kept on, so the Google Photos screensaver keeps working.

faq.q: Does casting still work, and can I undo it?
faq.a: Casting stays on. Restore everything turns every app back on and brings back the old home screen in one tap.
